run_confusion_matrix_tool: run the confusion matrix analysis tool on detection results to generate a visualization
calculate_confusion_matrix: calculate the confusion matrix from a dataset and detection results with configurable IoU thresholds
analyze_per_img_dets: analyze detection results on each image and update the confusion matrix with true positives and false predictions
plot_confusion_matrix: plot the confusion matrix as a normalized heatmap with matplotlib and optionally save to file
parse_args: parse command line arguments for the confusion matrix tool including config, prediction path, and save directory
